# Offline Classic proof runtime

Veil's main.cjs offline adapter and dedicated packaging scripts (collect-privacy-runtime.cjs, fetch-privacy-runtime.sh and privacy-manifest.py) were added on 2026-11-03 under GPL-3.0-or-later. This helper is provided WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY. You may modify and redistribute the covered source under its license; GPL-3.0 is included as LICENSE. It accepts notes on stdin and returns public proof data on stdout, with no network, signing or relayer client. No upstream cryptographic primitive was rewritten.

Pinned source packages and original notices are included in node_modules; exact dependency resolutions are in package-lock.json. Native addons, tests/examples and unrelated build products are excluded. The websnark WASM builder source and generated Groth16 module are included. Node 24.22.2 is an unmodified interpreter, with NODE-LICENSE and signed release provenance. Its source is available from https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.22.2/node-v24.22.2.tar.gz.

withdraw.circom and merkleTree.circom are unmodified tornado-core sources (Git blobs 54c38380a180471f43e40c92f825585c00784c52 and 3a669758c1963c590888d2792e7d393197737ce0); included circomlib circuit sources are in node_modules/circomlib/circuits. Circuit/proving-key artifacts are unchanged from tornado-cli commit 378ddf8b8b92a4924037d7b64a94dbfd5a7dd6e8, whose package.json pins circom 0.0.35. This helper uses published trusted-setup artifacts; it does not perform a new setup. Replacing the deployed pool's proving key with a newly generated setup will not work.

Build scripts and package manifests are included in source/build. In the source workspace run Scripts/fetch-privacy-runtime.sh, Scripts/privacy-manifest.py, then Scripts/build-app.sh. Modified local helpers can be installed without a publisher key: regenerate the inventory and ad-hoc sign the helper and outer app. No remote attestation or online allowlist controls local modification. The native Swift wallet uses a bounded JSON stdin/stdout protocol and does not link these libraries.
